derivation:
by
  simpa [← funext (fdBoundarySegment4_apply H), Function.comp_def] using
    (((AffineMap.lineMap (ρ : ℂ) (-1 / 2 + H * Complex.I)).comp (AffineMap.id ℝ ℝ - AffineMap.const ℝ ℝ 3)).hasDerivAt (x := t))
explanation: Instantiate the affine-map derivative theorem with the line map composed with the affine translation t ↦ t - 3. Its linear part at 1 simplifies to the stated chord. The current proof instead uses the line-map derivative and chain rule.
